activation_baseline.basis: Neris Solane v679-v2 repository seal plus the separately attributable four-failure/three-recovery route overlay supplied by the activation.

failure_retention_rule: Every timeout parser fault false assumption blocker workaround and failed witness remains visible at zero credit.
promotion_rule: A method becomes preferred only after a bounded passing witness; recovery never erases the paired failure.

startup_observations.description: The first combined activation display truncated repetitive middle sections.
startup_observations.recovery: Read bounded numbered windows through EOF and gave the truncated projection zero credit.

startup_observations.description: The first authorization-state projection truncated a large JSON record.
startup_observations.recovery: Read four bounded numbered slices covering the complete file and retained the first projection.

startup_observations.description: A guessed committed canonical-receipt filename did not exist.
startup_observations.recovery: Listed the exact owner receipt surfaces, then verified the external receipt and latch at their declared D-isolated locations.

startup_observations.description: Twenty inherited x2 agent-metadata rows carry checkout-time CRLF byte counts three bytes larger than their exact Git blobs; all normalized-LF hashes and all path sets replay exactly.
startup_observations.recovery: Preserve the size-metadata observation without rewriting Neris's immutable manifest or downgrading exact digest evidence.

startup_observations.description: A broad whole-tree filename probe exceeded its bounded display window and continued after output timeout.
startup_observations.recovery: Verified and stopped only the exact read-only Git child processes, then used proposal-indexed Git-object traversal.

startup_observations.description: A PowerShell preflight expression used an invalid inline command separator inside a value expression.
startup_observations.recovery: Materialized the branch and remote checks as scalar variables before constructing the result object.

startup_observations.description: The initial worktree command outlived its display window and a later preflight observed the branch before the path became visible.
startup_observations.recovery: Inspected exact process command lines, stopped only duplicate read probes, and let the single index-building checkout complete.
